CALL  TO ORDER  Gil Hurtado,  Mayor  called  a Special  City  Council  Meeting  to order at 5:31
  p.m.

ROLL  CALL  Yodit  Glaze,  City  Clerk

  Pilar Avalos,  Council  Member  Joshua Barron  and Council  Member  Al
  Rios;  City Treasurer  Jose De La Paz, City  Manager  Rob Houston,  City
  Attorney  Raul F. Salinas

CLOSED  SESSION

CONT'D  The Council  Members  recessed  into Closed  Session  at 5:45 p.m. and
  reconvened  at 6:37 p.m. with  all Members  of Council  present.  City

  Attomey  Salinas  reported  the following:

  1.  CONFERENCE  WITH  LABOR  NEGOTIATOR
  Pursuant  to Government  Code Section  54957.6

  Agency  Representation:  Rob Houston,  City  Manager
  Employee  Organizations:  SGPMMA,  SGMEA

  On item 1, City  Council  had a conference  with  Labor  Negotiator  regarding

  a report  on labor  negotiations.  Those  labor  negotiations  led to what will  be

  on Item No. 2 in the open session  and there was no reportable  action  taken

  in closed  session.

  2.  CONSIDER  THE  EVALUATION  OF PERFORMANCE  OF A
  PUBLIC  EMPLOYEE
  Pursuant  to Government  Code Section  54957

  a. City  Manager

  On item 2, the City Council received a report by the City Attorney  and

  City Manager on process and upon completion  of that report, there was  no

  reportable  action  taken.

  Mayor  Hurtado  asked if anyone  in the audience  wished  to speak and  any

  emails  received  on any of these items.

  Mr. Dominguez  once again requested  more information  on item 2. He
  questioned  the Brown  Act.

  Having  no one else come forward,  Mayor  Hurtado  closed  the audience
  portion.
